# dsh-plugin-permission-notify
A **DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin** that does two things:

1. **Makes “Auto review” the default permission preset.** dsh deliberately keeps the experimental
`a

uto` preset out of the “future sessions” default; this plugin re-applies it to every root
session (o

n creation and on mount).
2. **Raises native Windows notifications** — a real Windows toast (with th

e system sound) whenever a
turn finishes or the agent is blocked on a decision. The toast quotes the

**tail of the latest
assistant answer**, and **clicking it brings the DSH window back to the foregr

of the latest
assistant answer**, and **clicking it brings the DSH window back to the foreground**.
Plain ESM, no build step, no npm dependencies (it only uses `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, which ships

no build step, no npm dependencies (it only uses `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, which ships
with dsh).

(backup written next to it), and registers the `dshnotify:` protocol used by toast

## Configuration

Edit the managed block in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`, or re-run `install.ps1`
with f
lags (`-DefaultPreset off`, `-SkipExistingSessions`, `-NoSound`, `-Uninstall`).

l-access`, any configured preset name, or `off` |
| `applyToExistingSessions` | `true` | also switch

sessions that already exist when the plugin mounts |

length budget |

## How it works (short version)

* **Permission half** — on `agent/created` (and on mount) the plugin calls
`ctx.permissionPresets.se

t(session, 'auto')` for root sessions only. Sub-agent sessions are left
alone. If the `@deepseek-ai/

dsh-experimental-auto-review` bundle is not installed, `auto` is not an
available preset and the plu

gin logs a warning instead of failing. dsh **0.2.2** rejects session
appends while `session/created`

is still dispatching, so the plugin listens on `agent/created`
(which the built-in preset service i

tself pins on) and keeps a deferred/retried `session/created`
fallback for other runtimes.
* **Notif

ication half** — listens to `session/event` for `turn/end`, `approval/asked` and
`tool/call(ask_user

_question)`, keeps the newest `assistant/message` text per session as the
snippet, then spawns `asse

ts/notify.ps1` which raises a Windows toast.
* **Click half** — the toast uses protocol activation (

`dshnotify:activate`). The protocol is
registered in `HKCU\Software\Classes` at install time and lau

nches `activate.vbs` →
`activate.ps1`, which releases the Windows foreground lock with a synthetic `

ALT` and then calls
`SetForegroundWindow`, verifying the result.

Why the toast identity is `com.deepseek.dsh`, why a detached PowerShell child silently does
nothing,
and how the foreground lock was solved: see **docs/how-it-works.md**.
## Requirements

* Windows 10/11 with the **DeepSeek Harness desktop app** installed (that is where the
`com.deepseek

.dsh` AppUserModelID comes from).
* The `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` bundle enabled i

n the profile, if you want the
`auto` preset (`install.ps1` warns when it is missing).
* PowerShell
5.1 (shipped with Windows). No admin rights: everything lives in `HKCU` and `~/.dsh`.

Tested against dsh `0.2.1-rc.3` and `0.2.2-rc.1`. See CHANGELOG.md for the
`session/created` append-
guard fix shipped in v0.2.1.

## 中文说明
这个插件给 **DeepSeek Harness（桌面端）** 补两件事：

1. **把「自动审查」变成默认权限**。dsh 本身不允许把实验性的 `auto` 预设设成「未来会话默认值」，
插件在会话创建和自身挂载时，对**根会话**重新应用你指定的预设（默认 `auto`

）；子代理会话不动。
2. **原生 Windows 通知**。回答结束、需要确认操作、`ask_user_question` 等你做选择时弹系统 Toast，
带系统提示音；正文会引用**最近一条回
答的片段**（不是固定模板），**点击通知会把 DSH 窗口拉回前台**。
核心结论（详见 docs/how-it-works.md）：

* Windows 对未打包的桌面程序发 Toast，要求 AppUserModelID 对应开始菜单里带
`System.AppUserModel.ID` 的快捷方式；猜一个字符串会「`Show()

` 不报错但什么都不显示」。
DSH 桌面端的快捷方式里注册的是 `com.deepseek.dsh`，直接用就行。
* 用 `powershell.exe` 发 Toast 时不能 `spawn(.

.., { detached: true })`：进程会以退出码 0 结束
却不干活。改成普通子进程 + `stdio: 'ignore'`。
